investment-bank-path.title: Investment Banking Path

src-growing-up.summary: Matt started his career in investment banking before moving into startups to pursue a more visible impact. The details of this career path, including specific companies, are documented in his resume.

details.text: Matt started his career in investment banking, then moved into startups because he wanted to make an impact he could actually see.
details.heading: After football

details.text: The details of that path, from Citigroup to Postmates, Wonolo, Gametime and venture capital, are in his resume.
details.heading: After football

details.text: Matt worked as a Summer Investment Associate at Corazon Capital, where he sourced, diligenced, and closed a pre-seed investment, and led diligence on prospective deals across AI companions, consumer hardware, and EdTech.
details.heading: Work Experience

details.text: Matt was a Pre-MBA Associate and Venture Fellow at SkyDeck, where he sourced three companies across AI infrastructure, agent control, BaaS, and semiconductor startups, and established university relationships.
details.heading: Work Experience

details.text: Matt managed financial planning and goaling for Gametime, leading to the company's first-ever profitable quarter, and oversaw marketing budgets resulting in incremental revenue.
details.heading: Work Experience

details.text: Matt oversaw financial due diligence on capital fundraising for Wonolo, restructuring customer profitability analyses, and led a 'Living Wage' initiative for workers.
details.heading: Work Experience

details.text: Matt served as a Sr. Finance & Strategy Analyst at Postmates, where he was the primary analyst on fundraising and exit efforts leading to the $2.0Bn sale to Uber.
details.heading: Work Experience
